risks.risk: Whether it is truly a Singer (brand/model) and which exact model it is (affects parts availability and value).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the brand/model plate and any serial number label on the machine (plus a photo of the underside/inside label if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic vintage treadle sewing machine with unknown brand/model.

risks.risk: Whether it actually works (timing, feed, tension, needle bar movement) and whether any motor/electrical conversion works.
risks.proof: A short video showing the machine running and sewing a few straight stitches on fabric (or at least the needle moving with feed engaged).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/assumed needs servicing (worst case for remote buying).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (presser feet, bobbins, needles, belt, flat plate/attachments) and whether the set is complete.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of every included accessory and the manual, with counts (e.g., bobbins, feet, needles) and close-ups of the flat plate/attachments.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in a single wide shot (rust, bent needle bar, worn gears/bearings, cracked base, missing screws).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: needle area, feed dogs, tension dial, handwheel teeth/gears, and the base for rust/cracks (plus underside).
risks.if_unproven: Price as fairly used with possible wear (not “perfect working”).

risks.risk: Claim of 'Japanese made' may be incorrect; wrong origin affects value and buyer expectations.
risks.proof: Photo of any manufacturing label/marking showing country of origin.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the Singer brand/model plate and any serial number label (if present).
Video of the machine operating: needle movement + feed working, and ideally a short sewing test on fabric.
Photos laid out of all accessories included (bobbins, presser feet, needles, belt if any, flat plate/attachments) and the original manual (cover + a page).
Close-ups of the needle area, tension mechanism, feed dogs, and any motor/electrical parts (if it has a motor).
